fields.label: ancient airlock
fields.description: A hull airlock salvaged from a wreck older than anyone can date. The seal motors still hold pressure, slow and stubborn, and require solid wall on both sides to seat properly. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: ancient large airlock
fields.description: A wide hull airlock, big enough for a loaded cargo sled to pass through. The frame is scorched but the seal still seats true. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: stuck ancient airlock
fields.description: A hull airlock seized in its frame, warped by whatever wrecked the ship. It won't budge without being forced. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: stuck ancient large airlock
fields.description: A wide hull airlock seized in its frame, warped by whatever wrecked the ship. It won't budge without being forced. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: forced ancient airlock
fields.description: A hull airlock pried open by main force. The seal is ruined; it will never close again. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: forced ancient large airlock
fields.description: A wide hull airlock pried open by main force. The seal is ruined; it will never close again. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: empty ancient cryptosleep pod
fields.description: A cryptosleep pod, iced over and standing open. Whoever it once held is long gone — walked off the wreck, or never made it this far. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: wrecked shielded turret
fields.description: A gutted turret emplacement, its deflector housing crushed and its weapon long stripped for parts. Pure scrap now. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: wrecked spacer autocannon
fields.description: A heavy shipboard cannon torn loose from its mount, barrel bent and its targeting array long dead. Whatever crew it once defended is centuries gone. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: dead landing beacon
fields.description: A corroded landing beacon, its guide light long dark. No ship will ever answer its call again. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: dead ship terminal
fields.description: A single dark console, pried loose from some larger control station. The screen shows nothing. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: dead terminal bank
fields.description: A row of dark consoles, once a working control station. Every screen in it has been dead for longer than anyone alive can remember. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: corroded medical berth
fields.description: A rusted-out bed frame, its thin mattress somehow still mostly intact. It will hold a patient, poorly. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: dead transmitter beacon
fields.description: A stripped transmission mast, its antenna snapped and its power cell long drained. Nothing is listening on the other end. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: battered wargaming table
fields.description: A sturdy old tabletop built for pushing miniature armies across painted terrain. Its surface is scuffed and its edges dented, but the strategy games it hosts are as sharp as ever. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: ancient shielded turret
fields.description: A scavenged autonomous gun nest wrapped in a slab of ballistic plating, torn from some long-dead ship's hull. Its firing logic is dumb and indiscriminate - anything that moves in range gets shot, friend or foe. Burns through steel barrels fast, and it cooks off if hit hard enough. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: ancient shielded turret
fields.description: The barrel assembly of a scavenged shielded turret. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: ancient spacer autocannon
fields.description: A heavy ship-to-ship autocannon, ripped whole from a wreck's gun deck and dropped onto a mount. Slow to spin up, punishing once it does - its shells are built for punching through hull plate, not flesh. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: ancient spacer autocannon
fields.description: The cannon assembly of a scavenged ship autocannon. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: ancient landmine
fields.description: A buried charge scavenged from an old minefield, wired to a pressure-and-impact trigger. It sits invisible underfoot until something sets it off, and it's impossible to spot before that happens. Keep it well clear of other traps - the trigger is skittish. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: ancient floor heater
fields.description: A squat, outdated floor unit salvaged from a derelict's environmental deck. The insulation is shot and the casing is scorched, but wire it to power and it still throws real heat. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: ancient black box
fields.description: A gutted flight recorder pried from a wreck's crash frame, its casing still faintly lit by a dying indicator. Whatever data it once held is long past recovery - it's dead weight now, good for its metal. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: disabled ancient black box
fields.description: A flight recorder stripped of power and purpose, its casing dark and cold. Nothing left inside worth reading - just scrap waiting to be broken down. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage

fields.label: ancient blueprints bench
fields.description: A drafting bench salvaged from a wreck's fabrication bay, its surface still layered with brittle, water-stained schematics. The designs have long since faded past any use - it's just old furniture now. RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage
